column2: *Gulp!* A place you can hide something even when you're naked... that would be... uh...
Ihhihhihhi...!
Eww! You perverts!!
Heave-ho, heave-ho.
Hup, hup.
The golden Buddha is in place!
Good work! You may go.
Yes, ma'am!
Beautiful... Its features are beyond words.
Worthy of the collection of Panther Claw, the international crime syndicate! Ohohohoho!
Phew... A pretty face, she says? Tee-hee! Well, of course! Honey FLASH!
After all... I'm Honey!\n\nOkaaay, I need to meet up with Seiji-kun and the others!
So this is the security system.\n\nLet's shut it down and meet up with Seiji-kun and the others.
Is this... a security device?\n\nIf I shut it down, the moving floors should stop too!
This one?
Hyah!
Eek!
Uh-oh!
Nooo!
Yes!
It worked!
Kyaaa, Honey, you're amaaazing!
This must be the last barrier...
All right! Now I just have to find Seiji-kun and the others and meet up!
Ngh! After coming this far...!!
Honey! Get the gate open somehow!
Guess we've gotta wait till Honey opens the gate...
Honey-chan! Open the gate, old Danbei's coming to save you!
Open the gate before they find us, Honey-chan!
Honey, open it quick! Natsuko's scared...
I'm sure Honey will open the gate for us! Let's believe in her and wait!
Oh my! The gate is closed!
The gate's closed, it iiis...
Way to go, Honey!
All right! Let's go, everybody!
Woo-hoo, Honey-chan!
All righty! Old Danbei's coming now, Honey-chaaan!
Ah, Honey! The gate opened!
Everyone! Let's go!
It opeeened!
It went grrrrrind and the gate opened!
Oh, no way!
Honey, don't tell me you failed!?
Honey-chan... old Danbei's in a pinch...
It's no use... We'll just have to give up...
Oh, Honey! Will I never see you again...!?
No, no...!
Eeek! It's all over!
Oh, my my, is it no good?
Honey!
Waaah! I was so worried about you!
There, there! Natsu-chan, there's nothing to be scared of now!
Natsu-chan... I-I'm so jealous...
Oh...!? Wh-what...!?
Nooo, don't stare at me like that!
TO OPEN THIS DOOR, ID CARD A IS REQUIRED.
TO OPEN THIS DOOR, ID CARD B IS REQUIRED.
TO OPEN THIS DOOR, ID CARD C IS REQUIRED.
Now's my chance to defeat Sister Jill! I can't go back yet!
Jill-sama! The golden Buddha has vanished!
Wh-what! Mobilize everyone in the castle and search for it!
Yes, ma'am!
To steal the golden Buddha from this heavily guarded Mirage Castle...! How? Whose doing is this?
You! How did you get into this Mirage Castle!?
You're the one who brought me into this castle!
I brought you into this castle?
My body shone with gold, and you called my features beautiful...
Y-you were the golden Buddha!? Th-that's impossible!
Sometimes I'm a golden Buddha... And other times I'm Honey Kisaragi... But my true identity is...!! Honey FLAAASH!!
You are...!?
The super android Dr. Kisaragi built with all his heart and soul! The warrior of love who protects this world from the evil hands of Panther Claw! I am Cutie Honey!
Kyaaa, Honey, you're so cool! Wonderful!!
Like a moth to the flame, that's you! Instead of a golden Buddha, the far more valuable Airborne Element Fixer flew right in by itself! Honey! Your body now belongs to Sister Jill!
Sister Jill, let's settle this!
Curse you, Cutie Honey!\n\nIf it's come to this, I'll take you down with Mirage Castle!
Ohohohoho...! Crumble away along with the castle!
Sister Jill, you won't escape!
No, it's too dangerous!
...Sister Jill.
Look at that!
A black moon...!?
Eeek, what is THAT!?
The moon's all blaaack?
Wh-what on earth is that...!?
Honey, isn't that light pointing toward Science City?
Science City? Something's happened to {p} and the others...!
First I have to meet up with Seiji-kun and the others...!
The gate's shut, I can't get out. And I don't see a keyhole... I wonder if there's a device somewhere that opens the gate?
Zzz... zzz...
Mumble, mumble...
Everyone's worn out...
Who's there!
It can't be!? The remains of the Ma came back to life...!? I have to warn everyone, quick...!
Whoaaa!
Eeeek!
Wh-what the...? ...Gyah!
...As you command.
...The Moon of destruction!
...The Sun of rebirth!
